proves.claim: the fs lint exempts the runner probe by its exact path, where the node:fs import sits inside a script text the runner runs, and still flags a same-named file elsewhere

gate.logic-adapter-lints-fs.generated-pr.why: The probe cannot import the file-system adapter into a script that runs on another machine; without the exact-path exemption its row could not leave the ceiling, and a loose match would hide real offenders.
